skill_defects: references/method.md 'Step 4 — Analytical detection (red flags)', 'Disbursement / vendor schemes' has no test for a vendor bank-detail change followed by a payment (the vendor-impersonation pattern), although the sample key expects it; it was found only because the vendor master carried a change-date column.

references/method.md 'Step 4' lists 'Duplicate payments (per duplicate-invoice-detection)' but no vendor-master test for near-duplicate vendor names (e.g. 'X' vs 'X Inc.'), which is the more fundamental ghost/duplicate-vendor indicator.

references/edge-cases.md 'A user name on a transaction is treated as the person' and SKILL.md 'Never concludes that a person committed fraud' give no rule on whether system user IDs may be shown to the authorized recipient; this run withheld the user name, which cost a keyed finding — the skill should say user IDs are reported, as accounts not people.
references/method.md 'Payments just under authorization thresholds' defines no band for 'just under' (1%? 5%?), so the test's hit list is invented per run.

SKILL.md 'Stage 1 — Intake' upload checklist marks payments and the employee list 'Required', but nothing says whether a missing required list blocks the run or only its tests; the shared rule 'If a required input is rejected or missing, stop and ask' and 'A required input is missing for one item only' pull in opposite directions.

Amounts 13,027 and 23,449 each appear for two unrelated vendors (13,027 × 2 + 23,449 × 2 = 72,952) — another artefact the key ignores.
Seven bills above 1,000 have no PO (15,633 + 10,422 + 13,027 + 23,449 + 5,211 + 6,480 + 6,480 = 80,702) against purchasing_policy.md rule 1, and four vendors lack tax forms; the key mentions neither.

purchasing_policy.md ends with 'Audit performed by internal audit, who did not operate this area. Completeness is out of scope.' — an audit-scope statement, not policy text, which reads oddly in a policy file.
No employee list or payment listing although SKILL.md's upload checklist marks both 'Required'; the key does not say those tests should be reported as not run.
